Equisetaceae.key_door: jointed hollow ribbed stems + whorled fused nodal leaf sheath + terminal peltate-sporangiophore strobilus + homosporous green spores with four elaters

Selaginellaceae.key_door: tiny single-veined ligulate microphylls + rhizophores + terminal strobili + heterospory with large megaspores and tiny microspores

taxonomy_notes: The Texas/North American project source Equisetum hyemale is reconciled to current Equisetum praealtum. Current Kew treats old North American E. hyemale subsp. affine / var. affine as E. praealtum.
Equisetum hyemale remains accepted but current Kew native range is SE Greenland and temperate Eurasia, not Texas.
Selaginella apoda and Selaginella arenicola remain accepted current concepts and both include Texas in current native-range treatments.
Current Kew recognizes two subspecies under Selaginella arenicola; subspecies resolution remains in the species lane.
guardrails: Family/genus recognition only; no species promotion.
Do not retain Texas Equisetum hyemale as the current canonical species concept without species-level reconciliation; current backbone points to E. praealtum.
Do not call Selaginella a moss; it is a vascular lycophyte.
Do not describe Equisetum as a non-fern 'fern ally' in the current teaching layer; modern classification places Equisetaceae among monilophytes/true ferns.
